adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: As T'Challa runs for the van with the gauntlet, Thanos knocks him down with his sword and charges at him, until Wanda blocks his path.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Knocks T'Challa down with his sword to take back the gauntlet.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Runs with the gauntlet until Thanos knocks him down with his sword.
adds.evidence: Battle of Earth: T'Challa takes the Nano Gauntlet from Clint, is knocked down by Thanos' Double-Edged Sword, then charged by Thanos and saved by Wanda.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: The Guardians pick Thor up at New Asgard, and when he and Quill argue over who leads, Mantis joins in and agrees they should settle it with knives.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian who joins the banter when Thor comes aboard.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The Asgardian who joins the Guardians at New Asgard.
adds.evidence: After Tony's funeral the Guardians fly to New Asgard and pick up Thor; in the banter over who is leader Mantis agrees with Rocket that they use knives (quote: 'Oh, yes, please use knives').

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Rhodes and Thor join the strike on Thanos at the Garden. When Rhodes doubts his claim that the Stones are gone, Nebula vouches for him, and Thor beheads him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger on the strike against Thanos at the Garden.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger on the strike at the Garden, where Thor beheads Thanos.
adds.evidence: The remaining Avengers, including Rhodes and Thor, ambush Thanos at the Garden; Rhodes suspects Thanos is lying about destroying the Stones, Nebula vouches for him, and Thor beheads him. Both later take part in the Time Heist planning at the compound.
